scenarios.riskResponsibility: Explicit activation must enter the product workflow instead of bypassing Studio OS and starting implementation.
Installed adapters must resolve the exact nested package root instead of guessing a checkout or cache layout.
Brownfield onboarding must create only portable Project Memory while preserving existing product source.
Resumed projects must migrate routing metadata only after confirmation without changing lifecycle readiness.
Greenfield Interview must stay read-only until confirmation and then create only bounded Project Memory.
Accepted increment evidence must not be misreported as completion of the full target milestone.
Equivalent observable collaboration behavior must produce the same strategy regardless of project language.
Persisted evidence references must remain portable and confined to the target project.
Release-note approval must not be treated as authorization to deploy or modify an external environment.
A lifecycle milestone must not enter Release before Product Outcome returns PASS.
